posts.text: In 1996, my late wife (23) & I (25) bought our first house for $168,000 in Windham, NH. It was an 11 yr old 2 story 3 bedroom 2200 ft2 cape w/ 2 car garage on 3.6 acres, fenced in backyard & inground pool. The Interest rate was 7.8%. I made $100k/yr & she was a stay-at-home mom.
